plans.name: Yearly
plans.note: Everything, plus the VIP lounge on Telegram and in the app

plans.name: League pass
plans.note: Everything for one league, all season

plans.name: Single pick
plans.note: One pick from a game the characters are on

characters.name: The Simulator
characters.bio: 10,000 Monte Carlo runs of the game — the engine everyone reads; official on the heavy moneylines (-500 or shorter), anything else only at 80%+

characters.name: The Judge
characters.bio: weighs every witness by its graded accuracy (forecast combination)

characters.name: The Coach
characters.bio: keeps everyone honest — scales each character's confidence to its real hit rate; his own score from season scoring, rest, spots, revenge, weather and the news

characters.name: The Scorekeeper
characters.bio: every final built from its parts — touchdowns × what they bring + field goals, possessions × threes / twos / free throws, shots × the goalie — off the season's box scores

characters.name: The Commissioner
characters.bio: TheDesk Power Index — who's better and by how much, plus prestige and the all-time series

characters.name: The Banker
characters.bio: the secretary — reads every character's books (sport × bet type × favorite/dog/over/under) and backs the side the strongest accounts are on; builds the Master Parlay Sheet
